title: Serverless Architectures
summary: Four worked case studies that combine the serverless building blocks: a mobile to-do app (API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, Cognito user and identity pools, DAX, API caching), a global blog (CloudFront with OAC, DynamoDB global tables, Streams to Lambda to SES, S3-triggered thumbnails), a microservices platform (sync vs async integration) and offloading software downloads with CloudFront.
